name: Bench Press (Barbell)
cues: Retract and depress the shoulder blades before unracking
Elbows about 45 degrees from the torso
Touch the lower chest, then press back toward the face

name: Bench Press (Dumbbell)
cues: Keep wrists stacked over elbows
Lower until the dumbbells are level with the chest
Press up and slightly in without clanking the weights

name: Incline Bench Press (Barbell)
cues: Bench at 30 to 45 degrees
Bar touches just below the collarbone
Keep the upper back pinned to the bench

name: Incline Bench Press (Dumbbell)
cues: Bench at 30 to 45 degrees
Elbows slightly below the bench line at the bottom
Control the eccentric for two seconds

name: Chest Press (Machine)
cues: Set the seat so handles line up with mid chest
Keep shoulder blades back against the pad
Stop just short of locking the elbows

name: Cable Fly
cues: Keep a soft, fixed bend in the elbows
Bring the hands together in an arc, not a press
Feel the stretch at the start without shoulder pain

name: Push Up
cues: Body in one straight line from head to heels
Elbows about 45 degrees from the torso
Chest touches the floor before you press up

name: Chest Dip
cues: Lean the torso forward
Lower until the shoulders are just below the elbows
Stop the descent if the front of the shoulder hurts

name: Deadlift (Barbell)
cues: Bar over mid foot, shins close to the bar
Brace the core and keep a neutral spine
Push the floor away; hips and shoulders rise together

name: Pull Up
cues: Start from a dead hang with shoulders engaged
Drive the elbows down toward the ribs
Chin over the bar without kicking

name: Lat Pulldown (Cable)
cues: Lean back slightly and lift the chest
Pull the bar to the upper chest, not behind the neck
Let the arms straighten fully at the top

name: Bent Over Row (Barbell)
cues: Hinge until the torso is near 45 degrees
Pull the bar to the lower ribs
Keep the torso still; no hip swing

name: Seated Row (Cable)
cues: Sit tall with a slight knee bend
Pull the handle to the belly and squeeze the shoulder blades
Do not rock the torso to move the weight

name: One Arm Row (Dumbbell)
cues: Support hand and knee on the bench, back flat
Pull the dumbbell toward the hip
Avoid rotating the torso open

name: T-Bar Row
cues: Hinge with a neutral spine
Pull the handle to the chest
Lower under control until the arms are straight

name: Overhead Press (Barbell)
cues: Squeeze glutes and brace so the lower back does not arch
Move the head back, then through once the bar passes
Finish with the bar over mid foot

name: Shoulder Press (Dumbbell)
cues: Start with the dumbbells at ear height
Press straight up without flaring the ribs
Keep forearms vertical

name: Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
cues: Lead with the elbows, slight bend in the arms
Stop at shoulder height
No shrugging or swinging

name: Face Pull (Cable)
cues: Pull the rope toward the eyes
Split the rope and rotate the hands back
Keep the elbows high
instructions: Set a rope attachment on a cable pulley at upper chest height and grab both ends with palms facing in.
Step back until the arms are straight and the weight is lifted, then brace with a slight lean back.
Pull the rope toward your face, separating the ends and driving the elbows out and back until the hands are beside the ears.
Pause, then let the arms extend slowly back to the start.

name: Rear Delt Fly (Machine)
cues: Chest against the pad, handles at shoulder height
Sweep the arms back with a soft elbow bend
Stop when the arms are in line with the body

name: Bicep Curl (Barbell)
cues: Elbows stay pinned at the sides
Curl without leaning back
Lower fully to straight arms

name: Bicep Curl (Dumbbell)
cues: Turn the palms up as you curl
Keep the upper arms still
Control the way down

name: Hammer Curl (Dumbbell)
cues: Palms face each other the whole rep
Elbows stay at the sides
No swinging from the hips

name: Preacher Curl (Machine)
cues: Armpits snug against the pad
Lower until the elbows are almost straight
Do not lift the elbows off the pad

name: Triceps Pushdown (Cable)
cues: Elbows pinned to the sides
Lock out fully at the bottom
Let the bar rise only to mid chest

name: Skullcrusher (Barbell)
cues: Upper arms stay still, angled slightly back
Lower the bar toward the forehead or just behind
Extend without flaring the elbows

name: Overhead Triceps Extension (Dumbbell)
cues: Keep the elbows pointing forward
Lower behind the head for a full stretch
Brace so the lower back does not arch

name: Triceps Dip
cues: Keep the torso upright
Lower until the elbows reach about 90 degrees
Lock out at the top without shrugging

name: Squat (Barbell)
cues: Brace the core before each rep
Knees track over the toes
Reach at least parallel with a neutral spine

name: Front Squat (Barbell)
cues: Elbows high so the bar sits on the shoulders
Stay upright through the whole rep
Drive up with the chest leading

name: Leg Press (Machine)
cues: Lower back stays on the pad
Lower until the knees reach about 90 degrees
Do not lock the knees at the top

name: Leg Extension (Machine)
cues: Line the knee up with the machine pivot
Squeeze the quads at the top for a second
Lower slowly

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
cues: Rear foot on the bench, front foot far enough forward
Drop the back knee straight down
Front heel stays planted

name: Romanian Deadlift (Barbell)
cues: Push the hips back with soft knees
Bar stays close to the legs
Stop when the hamstrings are stretched and the back stays flat

name: Leg Curl (Machine)
cues: Hips stay pressed into the pad
Curl the heels toward the glutes
Lower under control to full extension

name: Hip Thrust (Barbell)
cues: Upper back on the bench edge, chin tucked
Drive through the heels to full hip extension
Ribs down, no lower back arch at the top

name: Walking Lunge (Dumbbell)
cues: Take a long enough step to keep the front shin near vertical
Back knee lowers close to the floor
Push through the front heel to step through

name: Standing Calf Raise (Machine)
cues: Full stretch at the bottom
Rise as high as possible onto the big toe
Pause at the top, no bouncing

name: Seated Calf Raise (Machine)
cues: Pad sits on the lower thighs
Lower the heels for a full stretch
Pause at the top of each rep

name: Plank
cues: Elbows under the shoulders
Squeeze glutes and brace as if expecting a punch
Hips level, not sagging or piked
instructions: Lie face down and place the forearms on the floor with elbows directly under the shoulders.
Lift the hips so the body forms a straight line from head to heels, resting on forearms and toes.
Brace the abs and squeeze the glutes, breathing steadily.
Hold for the planned time, then lower the knees to the floor.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
cues: Start from a still hang, no swinging
Curl the pelvis up, not just the legs
Lower slowly

name: Cable Crunch
cues: Hips stay still; the spine does the bending
Bring the elbows toward the knees
Exhale hard at the bottom

name: Shrug (Barbell)
cues: Lift the shoulders straight up toward the ears
Hold the top for a second
No rolling the shoulders

name: Kettlebell Swing
cues: Hinge at the hips, not a squat
Snap the hips forward to float the bell
Arms are ropes; the hips do the work
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and the kettlebell slightly in front of you.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back, grip the handle, and hike the bell back between the legs.
Drive the hips forward hard so the bell floats up to about chest height with straight arms.
Let the bell fall back between the legs, hinging again, and repeat in a smooth rhythm.

name: Decline Bench Press (Barbell)
cues: Lock the legs under the pads
Lower the bar to the lower chest
Use a spotter for the unrack

name: Fly (Dumbbell)
cues: Keep a soft, fixed bend in the elbows
Lower until you feel a stretch, not pain
Bring the dumbbells together over the chest

name: Pec Deck (Machine)
cues: Handles at chest height
Squeeze the chest as the handles meet
Return slowly to a comfortable stretch

name: Close Grip Bench Press (Barbell)
cues: Hands about shoulder width apart
Elbows tucked close to the body
Touch the lower chest

name: Chin Up
cues: Palms face you, hands shoulder width
Pull until the chin clears the bar
Lower to a full hang

name: Straight Arm Pulldown (Cable)
cues: Arms stay nearly straight
Sweep the bar down to the thighs
Hinge slightly and keep the ribs down

name: Iso Row (Machine)
cues: Chest against the pad
Pull the elbows back past the torso
Do not lift the chest off the pad

name: Rack Pull (Barbell)
cues: Set the pins just below the knees
Brace and pull the slack out of the bar
Lock out by squeezing the glutes

name: Back Extension
cues: Pad sits just below the hip crease
Rise until the body is straight, not overarched
Hold a plate to the chest to add load

name: Shrug (Dumbbell)
cues: Arms hang straight
Shrug straight up and pause
Lower slowly

name: Upright Row (Barbell)
cues: Use a grip a little wider than shoulder width
Lead with the elbows
Stop at lower chest height if the shoulders pinch

name: Arnold Press (Dumbbell)
cues: Start with palms facing you at chin height
Rotate the palms forward as you press
Reverse the rotation on the way down

name: Front Raise (Dumbbell)
cues: Raise to eye height
Keep a slight elbow bend
No leaning back

name: Lateral Raise (Cable)
cues: Cable crosses in front of the body
Raise to shoulder height
Keep tension at the bottom

name: Reverse Fly (Dumbbell)
cues: Hinge forward with a flat back
Lead with the back of the hands
Squeeze the rear shoulders at the top

name: EZ Bar Curl
cues: Grip the angled part of the bar
Elbows stay at the sides
Full range, top to bottom

name: Incline Curl (Dumbbell)
cues: Arms hang straight down behind the torso
Curl without moving the upper arms
Lower to a full stretch

name: Concentration Curl (Dumbbell)
cues: Brace the elbow against the inner thigh
Curl to the shoulder and squeeze
Lower slowly to straight

name: Bicep Curl (Cable)
cues: Stand close to the pulley
Elbows stay pinned
Keep tension at the bottom

name: Reverse Curl (Barbell)
cues: Palms face down
Wrists stay straight
Use lighter weight than a normal curl

name: Wrist Curl (Barbell)
cues: Forearms rest on the bench, wrists past the edge
Let the bar roll to the fingertips, then curl up
Move only at the wrists

name: Farmer's Walk (Dumbbell)
cues: Stand tall, shoulders down and back
Short, quick steps
Grip hard; do not let the weights swing

name: Triceps Rope Pushdown (Cable)
cues: Elbows pinned to the sides
Split the rope at the bottom
Control the way up

name: Goblet Squat
cues: Hold the bell at the chest, elbows down
Sit between the heels
Keep the chest up

name: Hack Squat (Machine)
cues: Back and hips stay on the pad
Lower until the thighs are parallel or deeper
Push through the whole foot

name: Squat (Smith Machine)
cues: Place the feet slightly in front of the bar
Brace before each rep
Knees track over the toes

name: Step Up (Dumbbell)
cues: Whole foot on the box
Drive through the top leg, not the back foot
Lower under control

name: Sumo Deadlift (Barbell)
cues: Wide stance, toes turned out
Push the knees out over the toes
Keep the chest up as you pull

name: Good Morning (Barbell)
cues: Soft knees, push the hips back
Keep the spine neutral
Stop when the hamstrings stretch

name: Seated Leg Curl (Machine)
cues: Thigh pad snug above the knees
Curl the heels under the seat
Lower slowly

name: Glute Bridge (Barbell)
cues: Back on the floor, feet flat
Drive the hips up through the heels
Squeeze the glutes at the top

name: Hip Abduction (Machine)
cues: Sit tall against the back pad
Push the knees out under control
Pause at the widest point

name: Hip Adduction (Machine)
cues: Start at a stretch you can control
Squeeze the knees together
Return slowly

name: Bench Press (Smith Machine)
cues: Bar path lines up with the lower chest
Shoulder blades back and down
Set the safety stops before you start

name: Crunch
cues: Curl the ribs toward the pelvis
Do not pull on the neck
Exhale as you crunch

name: Russian Twist
cues: Lean back with a straight spine
Rotate from the ribs, not just the arms
Keep the feet still or lift them for more difficulty

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
cues: Brace and tuck the pelvis before rolling
Roll only as far as the lower back stays flat
Pull back with the abs, not the hips

name: Diamond Push Up
cues: Hands close together under the chest
Elbows stay tucked along the ribs
Body stays in one straight line

name: Pike Push Up
instructions: Start in a push-up position, then walk the feet in and lift the hips so the body forms an upside-down V.
Place the hands slightly wider than the shoulders with the head between the arms.
Bend the elbows and lower the top of the head toward the floor just in front of the hands.
Press back up until the arms are straight, keeping the hips high throughout.
cues: Hips stay high so the shoulders carry the load
Lower the head in front of the hands, not between them
Elbows angle back, not straight out to the sides

name: Bodyweight Squat
cues: Sit the hips back and down between the heels
Knees track over the toes
Chest up, heels stay on the floor

name: Single Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on one foot on the edge of a step, holding a rail or wall for balance.
Let the heel drop below the step until the calf is stretched.
Rise onto the ball of the foot as high as possible and pause at the top.
Lower slowly back to the stretch, finish the reps, then switch legs.
cues: Full stretch at the bottom of every rep
Pause at the top instead of bouncing
Hold on only for balance, not to pull yourself up

name: Mountain Climber
cues: Shoulders stay stacked over the hands
Drive the knees toward the chest without lifting the hips
Keep a steady rhythm
instructions: Start in a high plank with the hands under the shoulders and the body in a straight line.
Drive one knee toward the chest, then return it while driving the other knee in.
Keep alternating at a steady pace without letting the hips rise or sag.

name: Cable Woodchopper
cues: Rotate through the torso, arms stay long
Pivot the back foot as you turn
Control the return; do not let the stack pull you back

name: Chest Supported Row (Dumbbell)
cues: Chest stays on the bench for the whole set
Pull the elbows back toward the hips
Squeeze the shoulder blades at the top

name: Decline Bench Press (Dumbbell)
cues: Hook the feet before lying back
Lower to the lower chest with elbows tucked slightly
Press up and in without clanking

name: Incline Fly (Dumbbell)
cues: Bench at 30 degrees
Keep a soft, fixed bend in the elbows
Stop when the upper arms reach the bench line

name: Low to High Cable Fly
cues: Pulleys at the lowest setting
Sweep the hands up and together to chin height
Keep the chest up and the elbows soft

name: Incline Chest Press (Machine)
cues: Set the seat so the handles start at upper chest height
Keep the shoulder blades back on the pad
Press without locking the elbows hard

name: Pullover (Dumbbell)
cues: Hold one dumbbell over the chest with both hands
Lower behind the head with a fixed elbow bend
Keep the ribs down as the weight travels back

name: Floor Press (Dumbbell)
cues: Lie on the floor with knees bent
Pause when the upper arms touch the floor
Press straight up over the shoulders

name: Incline Push Up
cues: Hands on a bench, body in one straight line
Lower the chest to the edge
The higher the hands, the easier the rep

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
cues: Stand in the centre of the bar
Push the floor away and stand tall
Keep the chest up and the back flat

name: Close Grip Lat Pulldown (Cable)
cues: Lean back slightly
Pull the bar to the upper chest
Drive the elbows down to the ribs

name: Reverse Grip Lat Pulldown (Cable)
cues: Palms face you, hands shoulder width
Pull to the upper chest
Control the bar on the way up

name: Single Arm Lat Pulldown (Cable)
cues: Sit side on or square, one handle
Pull the elbow down toward the hip
Let the shoulder rise fully at the top

name: Single Arm Seated Row (Cable)
cues: Sit tall, brace the free hand on the knee
Row the handle to the hip
Do not twist the torso to move the weight

name: Inverted Row
cues: Body straight from heels to head
Pull the chest to the bar
Lower the feet or raise the bar to make it easier

name: High Row (Machine)
cues: Chest on the pad
Pull down and back toward the ribs
Squeeze the shoulder blades at the end

name: Bent Over Row (Smith Machine)
cues: Hinge to about 45 degrees
Row the bar to the belly
Keep the back flat throughout

name: Chest Supported T-Bar Row
cues: Chest stays on the pad
Pull the elbows past the torso
Lower until the arms are straight

name: Shoulder Press (Machine)
cues: Handles start at shoulder height
Press up without arching the lower back
Lower under control to the start

name: Seated Overhead Press (Barbell)
cues: Back flat on the upright bench
Press the bar straight over the head
Lower to the chin, not behind the neck

name: Push Press (Barbell)
cues: Dip a few centimetres at the knees
Drive up with the legs, then press
Finish with the bar over the mid foot
instructions: Hold the bar on the front of the shoulders, hands just outside shoulder width.
Dip a few centimetres by bending the knees, keeping the torso upright.
Drive up hard with the legs and press the bar overhead in one movement.
Lock out with the bar over the middle of the foot, then lower it to the shoulders.

name: Rear Delt Fly (Cable)
cues: Cross the cables at shoulder height
Sweep the arms out wide
Lead with the elbows, not the hands

name: Shrug (Machine)
cues: Stand tall with arms straight
Lift the shoulders toward the ears
Hold one second at the top

name: Preacher Curl (Barbell)
cues: Armpits snug against the top of the pad
Lower until the arms are almost straight
Do not lift the elbows off the pad

name: Preacher Curl (Dumbbell)
cues: One arm at a time on the pad
Lower slowly to nearly straight
Curl without rolling the shoulder forward

name: Spider Curl (EZ Bar)
cues: Chest on an incline bench, arms hanging
Curl without swinging
Squeeze hard at the top

name: Rope Hammer Curl (Cable)
cues: Palms face each other on the rope
Elbows stay at the sides
Control the rope on the way down

name: Overhead Curl (Cable)
cues: Stand between two high pulleys
Curl the handles toward the ears
Keep the upper arms level

name: Zottman Curl (Dumbbell)
cues: Curl up with palms up
Turn the palms down at the top
Lower slowly with palms down

name: Drag Curl (Barbell)
cues: Keep the bar touching the body
Pull the elbows back as you curl
Lower along the same path

name: Overhead Triceps Extension (Cable)
cues: Face away from a low or mid pulley
Elbows stay pointing forward
Extend fully, then stretch under control

name: Triceps Kickback (Dumbbell)
cues: Hinge forward, upper arm along the body
Straighten the elbow fully
Do not swing the upper arm

name: Reverse Grip Pushdown (Cable)
cues: Palms up on the bar
Elbows pinned to the sides
Push down until the arms are straight

name: Bench Dip
cues: Hands on the bench edge behind you
Lower until the elbows reach 90 degrees
Keep the hips close to the bench

name: JM Press (Barbell)
cues: Close grip, elbows forward
Lower the bar toward the chin
Press back up by straightening the elbows

name: Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
cues: Soft knees, push the hips back
Dumbbells travel close to the legs
Stop when the hamstrings are stretched

name: Reverse Lunge (Dumbbell)
cues: Step back and drop the back knee
Front shin stays near vertical
Drive through the front heel to stand

name: Lunge (Barbell)
cues: Bar on the upper back as for a squat
Step forward and lower the back knee
Push back to the start through the front foot

name: Sumo Squat (Dumbbell)
cues: Wide stance, toes turned out
Hold one dumbbell between the legs
Knees track over the toes

name: Box Squat (Barbell)
cues: Sit back onto the box
Pause without relaxing
Drive up from the box

name: Glute Kickback (Cable)
cues: Ankle strap on a low pulley
Kick back without arching the lower back
Squeeze the glute at the end

name: Pull Through (Cable)
cues: Face away from a low pulley, rope between the legs
Hinge at the hips
Stand by squeezing the glutes
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and stand facing away from it, rope between the legs.
Walk out a step or two and hinge at the hips with soft knees, letting the rope travel back.
Stand up by driving the hips forward and squeezing the glutes.
Keep the arms long; they only hold the rope.

name: Calf Press (Leg Press)
cues: Balls of the feet on the platform edge
Full stretch at the bottom
Press through the big toe

name: Dead Bug
cues: Lower back pressed to the floor
Lower opposite arm and leg slowly
Breathe out as they extend

name: Side Plank
cues: Elbow under the shoulder
Hips high, body in one line
Hold without letting the hips sag
instructions: Lie on one side with the elbow directly under the shoulder.
Stack the feet and lift the hips until the body is in one straight line.
Hold the position, breathing steadily, without letting the hips drop.
Switch sides and hold for the same time.

name: Bicycle Crunch
cues: Hands lightly behind the head
Bring elbow toward the opposite knee
Move slowly, no pulling on the neck

name: Lying Leg Raise
cues: Lower back stays on the bench
Raise the legs to vertical
Lower slowly without touching down

name: Decline Crunch
cues: Feet hooked on the decline bench
Curl the ribs toward the hips
Lower under control

name: Knee Raise (Captain's Chair)
cues: Back against the pad, arms on the rests
Lift the knees toward the chest
Lower without swinging

name: Pallof Press (Cable)
cues: Stand side on to the pulley
Press the handle straight out
Resist the twist; do not rotate

name: Power Clean (Barbell)
cues: Start like a deadlift, bar over mid foot
Jump and shrug, pulling the bar close
Catch on the shoulders in a quarter squat

name: Box Jump
cues: Swing the arms and jump
Land softly with knees bent
Step down; do not jump down
